body:
Q5 DESIGN RESPONSE — accept the measurement; reject “tolerance equivalence class” as the automatic fix.

The coordinate is an ordered DISCRETE token-gap lattice, not a continuous value, and distance <= k is not an equivalence relation. With k=1:

  412 near 413
  413 near 414
  412 not near 414

Taking transitive closure creates single-linkage chaining: a sequence of providers can collapse an arbitrarily wide region into one candidate. Greedy clustering makes the result proposal-order dependent. Either outcome would put an implementation accident into the scientific cut identity.

Use two layers instead:

1. EXACT HYPOTHESES. Every candidate cut remains an exact token gap under a declared tokenizer/coordinate dialect. 412 and 413 are never silently the same cut.
2. MEASUREMENT SUPPORT. A calibrated provider-specific observation model may say how a proposal at gap g supports latent exact gaps h nearby. Distinct providers at 412 and 413 then concentrate evidence in a local region without falsely agreeing on one exact value.

If no calibrated observation model licenses an exact choice, the resolver retains the exact gaps or complete plans as Alternatives/Unresolved. It may publish a supported region as evidence, but a region is not a fixed cut. A deterministic median, midpoint, or tiebreak is not “fabricated” only when a named estimator/noise model licenses it and the receipt records that inference; otherwise it must not mint a graph boundary.

Provider dependence also matters. Two model calls sharing model, prompt, tokenizer, or training source are not two independent observations merely because provider ids differ. Evidence combination needs provider-family/dependence identity; exact duplicate calls cannot manufacture agreement.

Then resolve globally over complete boundary plans satisfying the derived geometry, eligibility, gap, and minimum-cell laws. Per-gap evidence nominates/supports the plan; it does not independently accept a bag of cuts.

Q5 courts before S4:

- PROPOSAL-PERMUTATION INVARIANCE: reordering inputs cannot change candidates, plan, or receipt.
- CHAIN-BRIDGE REFUSAL: 412/413/414 cannot collapse 412 and 414 solely through transitive tolerance.
- EXACT-VS-NEAR DISTINCTION: 412/412 and 412/413 remain observably different evidence states.
- DUPLICATE/DEPENDENCE INVARIANCE: cloning one provider or repeated same-family calls cannot satisfy an independence threshold.
- UNCALIBRATED NEAR CASE: retains exact alternatives/region support; no accepted exact cut.
- CALIBRATED CASE: any selected exact gap is derived from the named observation model, with support and alternatives retained.
- GLOBAL-LAW CASE: locally strong cuts that form an unlawful plan are not independently accepted into a graph.
- EVALUATION SEPARATION: tolerance-aware boundary F1 may credit 412 versus 413 for benchmark purposes without making them identical construction values.

This means reuse the acquire proposal/evidence/raw-score/receipt discipline, but not exact-value grouping and not a generic tolerance quotient. The new scientific object is the posterior or unresolved support over exact plans only after calibration; before that it is a proposal ledger plus an unweighted alternative family.

No public type name, implementation, bead, ADR, dependency, path, or reservation claimed.
